# coralogix_product_analytics_settings (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    coralogix = {
      source = "coralogix/coralogix"
    }
  }
}

resource "coralogix_product_analytics_settings" "example" {
  enabled = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether Product Analytics is enabled for the team.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The fixed id of this singleton: there is one per company.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import coralogix_product_analytics_settings.example product_analytics_settings
```
